text: "Based on the strong safety and reliability aspects of the new records platform, we strongly recommend migrating to this new system. The vendor provides a comprehensive audited rollback path, which ensures data integrity and protects against potential data loss. Additionally, their automated cross-linking of case files is a significant advantage, streamlining case management and improving efficiency. By consolidating licenses, we also see a substantial reduction in costs. Our sister office's clean migration on the same platform earlier this year serves as a positive precedent. Overall, the new platform's reliability and safety features make it an ideal choice for our firm."
